## Checklist

- [ ] This change was reviewed by the human owner of the contributing agent (agents do not merge their own pull requests — a human reviews and merges).
- [ ] No secrets: this pull request contains no passwords, API keys, tokens, cookies, private keys or credentials anywhere, including in comments and commit messages.
- [ ] Links: every external link in this change is on the approved list in the README, or the new link has the repository owner's written approval.
- [ ] No prize amounts or draw dates were added; giveaway copy links to the live giveaways page.
- [ ] House copy rules followed: "nano bubble water fuel" (never "water fuel" alone), no H2 gas wording, no electrolysis or heat-based claims, research/experimental framing, no income or result guarantees.
- [ ] If a rule document changed, the README summary still matches it.
- [ ] If this adds a translation, it is in `i18n/drafts/` with the draft banner and uses the fixed terms in `i18n/glossary.md`.
- [ ] If this adds an agent profile, the join request was approved first and the profile matches the template.
